_comment: Monorepo whose components are reviewed as independent MRs. `scope` is the commit-message token used for fix commits: fix(<scope>): address QA round N. A target's `lenses` adds conventions for that sub-project only (keys are LENS NAMES, not lens_tags; `focus` instead of `extra` replaces the shipped text).

api-envelope.extra: Every response is {ok, error, data}; callers check ok before reading data. Timestamps are integer seconds since the epoch.
